title: Characterizing Performance, Power, and Energy of AMD CDNA3 GPU Family
problem: AMD CDNA3 (MI300X, MI325X) GPU performance, power, and energy characteristics are not well characterized for HPC/AI workloads.
motivation: CDNA3 is new generation for HPC and generative AI; understanding real performance/power/energy is critical for procurement and optimization.
method: Researchers independently tested AMD's MI300X and MI325X GPUs using focused tests (microbenchmarks) that measure specific capabilities—compute speed, memory access speed, and data throughput—plus real AI and scientific computing applications. This approach reveals both peak performance and real-world behavior while tracking speed, power consumption, and energy efficiency.
key_novelty: This provides the first comprehensive independent testing of AMD's MI300X and MI325X GPUs to measure their speed, power consumption, and energy efficiency.
limitations: Characterization paper; limited novel optimization techniques; specific to CDNA3.
